summary: Tested the new 'Sub Item' column enhancement (backend + frontend). Backend: extended /app/backend/tests/test_checksheet.py to assert sub_item persistence on POST/PUT /api/checksheet-templates (create with sub_item='Bearing depan' + update adding second item sub_item='Line 1' — both returned & re-fetched via GET list) and on PUT /api/schedules/{id}/checksheet (sub_item='Line utama' & 'Bearing belakang' persisted and read back via GET /api/schedules). All 10 pytest cases in test_checksheet.py passed (checksheet_results.xml). Frontend: Playwright — TemplateManager 'Sub Item' column present, template-subitem-0 input persists on save & reload (verified with TEST_SubItem_* template, then deleted). ChecksheetDialog admin: loading 'Checksheet Kompresor Udara' template populates 5 rows including sub_item; typing 'Kompresor A - Line 1' and 'Head 1' into checksheet-subitem-0/1 and saving persists — reopen shows both values retained; auto-suggest OK for value=7 (range 6-8) works; Cetak BAP triggers PDF download 'BAP-Checksheet-GOLIVE--.pdf' with no JS errors. Operator user view: Sub Item column header renders (as 'SUB ITEM' via CSS uppercase); sub_item values visible as plain text; 0 subitem inputs, 0 save button, 0 template select, 1 Cetak BAP button; manage-templates and add-schedule buttons hidden. Role gating retained via pytest.

issues: DialogContent still missing aria-describedby (a11y warning, non-blocking, carried over from iteration_2)
SignaturePad canvas Canvas2D getImageData warning (perf, non-blocking, carried over)

critical_code_review_comments: TemplateItem.sub_item and ChecksheetItem.sub_item are Optional[str] with default '' — safe backward compat with older docs.
pdf.js head order [No, Item Pemeriksaan, Sub Item, Nilai, Satuan, Standar, Hasil, Catatan] matches didParseCell column index 6 for Hasil coloring — consistent.
ChecksheetDialog.loadTemplate maps sub_item defensively (i.sub_item || '') — safe against pre-enhancement templates without the field.
Table 'SUB ITEM' header is uppercased via CSS text-transform; visible correctly but tests must be case-insensitive when reading textContent/inner_text.

Carried over from iteration_1/2: /app/backend/tests/test_simin_api.py still uses obsolete email-based login and should be deleted or updated. @app.on_event startup/shutdown deprecated on FastAPI current versions.
